question: Under the India–Oman Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) that entered into force on June 1, 2026, what percentage of India’s exports to Oman by value will receive duty-free access?
solution:
The correct answer is __**99.38%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• The **India–Oman Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)** officially entered into force on **June 1, 2026**, marking a new era of strategic economic partnership.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• **Duty-Free Access:** The CEPA provides zero-duty access for **99.38%** of India’s exports to Oman by value. This covers **98.08%** of Oman’s tariff lines.
• **Comparison with MFN:** Prior to this agreement, under the **Most Favoured Nation (MFN)** regime, only **15.33%** of India’s exports entered Oman duty-free.
• **India’s Reciprocal Offer:** India has offered tariff liberalization on **77.79%** of its tariff lines, which covers **94.81%** of imports from Oman by value.
• **Immediate Effect:** All zero-duty concessions for Indian exports come into effect immediately, providing an instant competitive advantage in Oman’s **USD 28 billion** import market.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• **Bilateral Trade:** Trade between the two nations reached **USD 11.18 billion** in **FY 2025-26**, up from **USD 10.61 billion** in FY 2024-25.
• **Signing Details:** The agreement was signed on **December 18, 2025**, in Muscat in the presence of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Sultan Haitham bin Tarik Al Said**.
• **Sector Benefits:** Labor-intensive sectors such as **Gems and Jewellery**, **Textiles**, **Marine Products**, and **Pharmaceuticals** are expected to see significant growth.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• **Strategic Milestone:** India has become only the **second nation** after the **United States** to secure a comprehensive bilateral trade pact with Oman.
• **Logistics Gateway:** Oman’s hubs at **Sohar, Duqm, and Salalah** will serve as a gateway for India to reach the wider **GCC** and **East African** markets.
• **Services Offer:** Oman has made its best-ever offer by covering **127 services sub-sectors**, including healthcare, IT, and engineering.
